tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam snang sgyu drwa nas gsung zhing / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas bshad pa'i bsrung ba lnga gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang snying po gsal ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pañtsa rak+ṣa ya/ rnam snang sgyu drwa nas gsung zhing sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas 'byung ba'i bsrung ba lnga gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu/ zlum gtor/ chu gnyis nyer mchod/ rang gi mdun du ting shags me tog slob ma la dgos pa'i chab maṇ+ḍal 'bru bcas bshams la/ mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs nas oṃ badz+ra shap+ta swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ sogs dang so so'i phyag rgya bya zhing / mthar rol mo dkrol te byin dbab/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mdor bsdus bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wā sngags brjod de/ rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du praṃ ser po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus/ yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab sngo ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na rdo rje/ zhags pa/ dgra satwa/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhi ba'i rgyan dang na bza' can/ g.yon brkyang ba'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam zhing / oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti pa re swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi skal ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsams/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gong bdag bskyed kyi rigs 'gres sbyar la bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa bzhugs dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ bha ga wa ti ma hā pra ti sa re sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis nyer mchod kyis mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ ā kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng bsam la/ spro bsdus dmigs pas thugs rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing / gong ltar bzlas pa ci rigs bya/ slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas la/ snyims pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyi zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang / 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo nyan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la 'jug sgo mang du yod pa las 'dir rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas lha'i rnal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa rnams/ 'phags yul gyi slob dpon so sos thugs nyams su bzhes shing / sgrub pa'i thabs rgyas bsdus sna tshogs mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kun las btus pa'am/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa'i bstan bcos chen po nas 'byung ba'i yi dam khyad par can rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba gsungs pa las 'dir rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nas gsungs pa'i bsrung ba lnga gtso rkyang las 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub nas/ khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ maṇ+ḍal dbul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ slob dpon la lhag pa'i lha dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas/ rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul te/

me tog dang bcas pa thal mo sbyar nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thib pa ltar bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas te/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum nas sogs pa'i nas sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ haṃ zhes brjod pas khyed rang gi phung po khams dang zhes sogs kyi slob ma rnams bdag bskyed ltar zhal phyag rdzogs par bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de thams cad kyi thugs bskul te thugs kha nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i sku tshad med grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang gi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlab par mos pa mdzod/ ces pa dang rol mo bya zhing / sngags dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes yang yang brjod pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ lus bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos pa bya ste/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces dang / sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug de ltar lan gsum bzlas pa'i dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gi nas/ bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos par mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /'di la bgo bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma yi dam gyi lhar bzung bar bgyi'o/

/lan gsum/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ ngag bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re thugs kha nas rgyangs kyi bye nas byon pa khyed rang gi spyi bo nas thim ste thugs kha'i praṃ yig dang dbyer med du gyur par mos pa byas/ de'i ngang nas lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gtad pas 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim zhing / rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ sa bon de yang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ nam mkha' lta bu rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas te cung zad cig mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ltar byas pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ sems bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlab snyam du mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ gtso bos maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs dang chos bsngo byas la slob ma rang gnas su btang / tshom bu la mchod bstod/ 'dod don zhus te/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/

/ces sogs kyis mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes dang / mtheb srin gyis se gol byas pas/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsams/ bsngo smon shis brjod rnams bya'o/ /des khog phub nas lha mo gzhan bzhi'i mngon rtogs las/ rma bya chen mo ni pad zla la maṃ las rma bya chen mo ljang khu zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal ljang / g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas gsum na rma bya'i mjug sgro/ mda' mchog sbyin/ g.yon na rin po che'i rnga yab/ gzhu/ dku g.yon du bum pa rnams 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ zhi ba'i rgyan dang / na bza' 'chang ba/ skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ ma hā ma yū rī bir+ya ra dz+nyī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ ma hā ma yū rī bīr+ya ra dz+nyī/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs spyi bstod bya/ stong chen rab 'joms ni pad zla bh+rūm̐ las/ stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma/ g.yas na ral gri/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon na gzhu/ zhags pa/ dgra satwa rnams 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i rgyab brten dang / zhi ba'i rgyan dang cha lugs can/ rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gi dbur brgyan/ oṃ bh+rūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ ma hā sa hā pra pra mar+dha na ba ra si bhi da mī ge ma ṇi badz+ra nī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mtshan sngags/ ma hā sa ha pra pra mar+dha spyi bstod bya/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin ni pad nyi la hūm̐ las/ gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas rdo rje dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon dgra satwa dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ rgyan dang bzhugs tshul 'dra/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ hūm̐ swāhā/ mtshan sngags/ ma hā man+t+ra ma nu sa re/ spyi bstod bya/ bsil ba'i tshal ni/ pad nyi la dz+rīṃ las bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog dmar mo/

zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas phreng ba dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon lcags kyu dang thugs kar po ti 'dzin pa/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ 'od dpag med kyi dbur brgyan/ oṃ dz+rīṃ swāhā/ mtshan sngags ma hā pī ta pa nī/ spyi bstod bya'o/ /zhes bsrung ba lnga gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun blos bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 kun dga' blo gros/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas bshad pa'i srung ba lnga gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
